body:
celia: Quick announcement: launching a pilot of a new Dedicated QoS tier: 'shared-preemptible'. Goal: offer lower-cost burst capacity to Dedicated customers for non-latency-sensitive batch inference. Pilot region: eu-north-1 (Stockholm). Launching in 4h to a small set of customers.

marco: What hardware for the pilot?

celia: We'll use a mixed pool of a100x and rtx8000 nodes, labeled as `shared-preemptible`. Pool id: pool-sharedpreempt-eun1-01. Expected nodes: 48.

sre-bot: [automation] pool-reserve start: pool_id=pool-sharedpreempt-eun1-01, nodes=48, owner=@celia

ola: Ops note: Preemptible behavior = random preemption for up to 15% of nodes during high cluster demand. Workloads should be checkpointable. We will advertise 75% availability SLO for the pilot.

marco: Billing/quotas?

celia: New billing tag: `dedicated:shared-preemptible.eu-north-1`. Pricing tier is 40% off Dedicated baseline (internal pricing doc updated). Quotas will be managed separately from standard Dedicated pools (quota family: dedicated_preemptible).

nate: Is there a Console UI change or API flag?

celia: Console: new toggle "Allow shared preemptible" under Dedicated pool preferences. API: submit request with `capacity.qos=shared_preemptible`. Only visible to customers on the Pilot list.

ola: SRE checklist for pilot:
1) Set preempt-probability = 0.10 for first 24h, then monitor
2) Monitor job restart rate, lost_tokens metric, and cold_start_count
3) If lost_tokens > 0.5% over 15m, reduce preempt-probability to 0.05
4) Escalate to infra if node preemptions > 20% in any 30m window

sre-bot: [automation] pool-reserve complete: pool_id=pool-sharedpreempt-eun1-01, state=allocated

marco: Any runtime compatibility concerns? Will checkpointing require SDK changes?

celia: No SDK changes required. Recommend customers use graceful failure handlers. We will add helper libs in the next SDK patch to surface preempt events. Runtime team added `preempt_signal` hook in 0.9.7.

salesops: I'll notify pilot customers and tag their accounts. Should we add an opt-in form?

celia: Yes. salesops to send opt-in link (internal pilot sign-up). Limit first wave to 10 accounts.

nate: Fallback routing plan?

ola: Fallback: if >8% of pilot traffic experiences preemption within 10m, route new jobs to the customer's reserved Dedicated pools (if available) or mark jobs as queued until capacity frees. Add a log entry with `qos=shared_preemptible` for audit.

marco: Perf expectations?

celia: Should behave like existing Dedicated in steady state. We expect slightly higher tail latency during preemption events. We'll publish a short note in the Pilot FAQ.

sre-bot: [audit] pilot_announced by celia at 1921002222

celia: Action items:
- salesops: send opt-in + update contracts (ETA 6h)
- runtime: release 0.9.7 note about preempt_signal (ETA 8h)
- infra: confirm billing tag propagation (ETA 2h)
- sre: add monitors + dashboard widgets (ETA 3h)

salesops: Acknowledged. Will coordinate messaging and update the marketplace tile to show "Shared preemptible (pilot)".

celia: Will post a follow-up once the pilot is live with links to docs and the opt-in form.
